title: Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?
abstract: arXiv:2610.35826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. translated_title: 理解Jev式系统一模型：结构能否减少选择偏差？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.35826v1 公告类型：new 摘要：尽管有要求忽略呈现顺序的指令或引出推理的提示，大型语言模型（LLM）中的选择偏差仍可能持续存在。近来对Jev式系统一行为的复现工作产生了一个不断壮大的模型家族，这些模型直接在给定候选选项上预测概率。然而，在多选项任务中，针对Jev各版本、Jev复现模型以及生成式LLM之间选择偏差的系统性比较仍然有限。这就留下了一个核心问题：Jev式决策结构能否减少选择偏差？我们通过一个简单的测试来回答这个问题：在保持问题和候选内容不变的情况下打乱选项顺序。我们在两个Jev版本、十二个Jev复现模型和六个生成式LLM上，追踪个体答案在八种呈现方式下的表现，并将其与固定顺序重复进行比较。在我们从两个基准收集的1,700个问题的主要数据集上，Jev的准确率变化不到两个百分点……
tldr: 本文通过在保持问题内容不变的前提下打乱选项顺序的简单测试，系统比较了两个Jev版本、十二个Jev复现模型和六个生成式LLM在多选项任务中的选择偏差，探究Jev式决策结构能否减少选择偏差。
en_tdlr: Using a simple option-shuffling test that keeps question content fixed, this paper systematically compares selection bias across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs in multi-option tasks, investigating whether Jev-style decision structure reduces selection bias.
